author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices steady beat, finding one special note, echoing short patterns, counting to three and taking turns, with a gentle tune about a lamb.

classes.title: Sway with the little lamb
classes.goal: Hear the whole song and notice that the first tune comes back again.

mathTarget.parentLine: Noticing that a tune comes back the same

classes.parentPrompt: Sway with your child; when the first tune comes back, gasp and point: again!
classes.childAction: Sway with the song and shout "again!" when it repeats.
classes.bridge: The lamb follows Mary everywhere, and the tune follows itself back.

intro.caption: Let's sway like a lamb
intro.parentCue: Sit together, sway side to side

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for a tune that repeats.

classes.title: Little lamb steps
classes.goal: Tap one steady beat, one tap for each lamb step, while the grown-up plays.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand on your child's hand and tap together, one tap per beat.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for every lamb step.
classes.bridge: Each tap is one little hoof on the path: step, step, step.

intro.caption: The lamb walks: step, step
intro.parentCue: Pat your knees slowly together first

games.caption: Slow lamb steps
games.parentCue: Tap slowly with your child, one per beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat, together.

classes.title: Find the lamb's note E
classes.goal: Find the special note E by using the two black keys as a landmark.

mathTarget.parentLine: Finding a place by what sits next to it

classes.parentPrompt: Guide your child's finger over two black keys, then slide right to E.
classes.childAction: Touch the two black keys, slide right, and press E gently.
classes.bridge: E is the lamb's door, just right of the two black keys.

intro.caption: Where does the lamb live?
intro.parentCue: Point to two black keys together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding E next to the two black keys.

classes.title: Mama sheep, baby lamb
classes.goal: Find E in a low place and a high place and hear they match.

mathTarget.parentLine: One note lives in two houses: low left, high right

classes.parentPrompt: Say "mama" in a deep voice for low E, "baby" in a tiny voice for high E.
classes.childAction: Hop between low E and high E, deep voice then tiny voice.
classes.bridge: Low E is mama sheep on the left; high E is baby lamb.

intro.caption: Mama sheep says baa low
intro.parentCue: Use a deep, slow baa voice

games.caption: Baby lamb sings up high
games.parentCue: Point right, to the high side, together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the same note, low and high.

classes.title: Baa-baa echo
classes.goal: Hold two or three notes in mind, then copy them back on the keys.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping a short line of sounds in mind, in order

classes.parentPrompt: Play the short call, then fold your hands and wait for your child's answer.
classes.childAction: Listen to the lamb's call, then call it back the same.
classes.bridge: The lamb calls baa-baa across the field; you call back the same.

intro.caption: The lamb calls, you answer
intro.parentCue: Sing baa-baa, let your child copy

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening and copying short patterns.

classes.title: Down the hill and up
classes.goal: Echo patterns that walk down the hill and back up the same way.

mathTarget.parentLine: Going down three steps, then up the same three

classes.parentPrompt: Walk your fingers down your child's arm for E-D-C, back up for C-D-E.
classes.childAction: Walk down the hill, then walk back up the same way.
classes.bridge: E, D, C: the lamb walks down the hill to the left, then back up.

intro.caption: The lamb walks down the hill
intro.parentCue: Walk fingers down your child's arm

games.caption: Down the hill: E, D, C
games.parentCue: Point to each lit key, nice and slow

games.caption: Up the hill: C, D, E
games.parentCue: Cheer when the lamb reaches the top

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a pattern going down and back up.

classes.title: Wait for the lamb's E
classes.goal: Wait and listen, then play E at its moments in the song.

mathTarget.parentLine: Little lamb ends with three Es: one, two, three

classes.parentPrompt: Play your notes; count one, two, three out loud as your child plays E.
classes.childAction: Wait for your turn, then play E: one, two, three!
classes.bridge: Three Es in a row are three lamb hops: hop, hop, hop.

intro.caption: Wait, wait, now it's E!
intro.parentCue: Hands in lap until E comes

games.caption: Three hops: one, two, three
games.parentCue: Count out loud with each E

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting your turn and counting three.

classes.title: Two notes: D and E
classes.goal: Hear the difference between D and E and play each one when it comes.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting each sound: is it D or is it E?

classes.parentPrompt: Point to D or E just before it comes, then let your child press it.
classes.childAction: Listen, choose D or E, and press the right one.
classes.bridge: D sits between the two black keys; E is next door, on the right.

intro.caption: Two friends: D and E
intro.parentCue: Touch D, then E, saying their names

games.caption: Little lamb: D, D, D
games.parentCue: Hold up three fingers, count with each D

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing D and E and taking turns.

classes.title: One beat, two players
classes.goal: Play the whole song together and keep one shared beat, even after a miss.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players moving to one even beat

classes.parentPrompt: Nod your head on every beat and keep going, whatever notes happen.
classes.childAction: Play your notes and nod along with your grown-up.
classes.bridge: You and your grown-up walk the lamb together, side by side.

intro.caption: We play it together
intro.parentCue: Nod the beat before you start

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing together on one steady beat.

classes.title: A lamb concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the song from start to end for teddy and feel the long last note.

mathTarget.parentLine: Every song has a start and a resting end

classes.parentPrompt: Seat teddy as the audience; hold the last C long, then bow together.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, hold the last note, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: The last note is low C, home: hold it long like a hug.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
